newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 9.3 PCT IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 9.3 PCT IN Q1.

text.p: Estonian industrial sales rose by 9.3 percent during the first quarter in comparison with the same period in 1996, the statistics office said on Tuesday.
Industrial sales totalled 7.2 billion kroons in the first quarter, the statistics office added in a statement.
The biggest rise was in the sales of wood manufacturing at 59.4 percent and in the sales of construction materials manufacturing at 40.1 percent.
